A skilled '''agent''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] was forced to go silent to avoid pursuers during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Because of this, he was unable to do a scheduled check-in from the<ref name="TOR" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Missing Asset" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual associated with one of the two rival governments sent a companion of theirs to find out why the [[Agent/Legends|agent]] had missed his check-in. The companion's arrival chased away the agent's pursuers.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The SIS agent was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Missing Asset" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
